en: Hello there, young Trainer! The name's Baoba. I'm the warden of a Safari Zone, or I will be soon.
I'm building it past the cliffs on the far side of Cianwood City. Wild Pokémon from all over, free for the catching!
It isn't quite ready yet. When it is, I'll give you a ring, so don't you go changing your number!
The workmen are still busy at my Safari Zone. I'll ring you the moment its gate opens!
Good morning! I'm Monica of Monday. Monday is the start of the week, and the start of my brothers' and sisters' days!
text: Bună dimineața! Sunt Monica de luni. Lunea e începutul săptămânii și începutul zilelor fraților și surorilor mele!

en: A Pokémon that holds a Sharp Beak hits harder with Flying-type moves. Have a happy Monday!
text: Un Pokémon cu Sharp Beak lovește mai tare cu atacuri de tip Flying. O luni fericită!

en: There are seven of us, one for each day. Have you met the others? They're all over Johto.
text: Suntem șapte, câte unul pentru fiecare zi. I-ai cunoscut pe ceilalți? Sunt peste tot prin Johto.

en: Today isn't Monday? Oh dear, I must have lost track of the week. Monday is my day!
text: Azi nu e luni? Vai, trebuie să fi pierdut șirul săptămânii. Lunea e ziua mea!
